note: Easy cases cover the derived block plugin (paragraph_field), the admin_title field, and the module settings. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the paragraph_blocks.settings config object (schema: paragraph_blocks.schema.yml; install defaults max_cardinality=10, individual_block_ui=false, suppress_label=false, library_items_only=false) — only local config is read/written, and reset/cleanup restore those shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: With the paragraph_blocks module enabled, what Layout Builder block does it give me for placing an individual paragraph value, and under which block category do those blocks appear?
evals.expected_output: It derives a block plugin with base id 'paragraph_field' (derivative ids like paragraph_field:node:field_paragraphs:0:page) shown under the 'Paragraphs' block category. Each derivative renders one delta of a paragraph reference field.

evals.prompt: How does paragraph_blocks let editors tell apart the different paragraph blocks when placing them in Layout Builder? What field does it add to paragraphs?
evals.expected_output: It adds an 'admin_title' base field to paragraph entities; that admin title identifies each paragraph in the placement UI and becomes the block label. A paragraph type can define a default_admin_title (token-aware).

evals.prompt: Where do you configure paragraph_blocks globally, and what does the 'max_cardinality' setting control for unlimited paragraph fields?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/content/paragraph_blocks (config object paragraph_blocks.settings). max_cardinality limits how many delta blocks are offered for placement for unlimited-cardinality paragraph fields (default 10).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the paragraph_blocks configuration and tell me the current max_cardinality value (the cap on how many paragraph delta blocks unlimited fields offer).
On this Drupal site, inspect the paragraph_blocks configuration and tell me whether the block label field is suppressed on paragraph block placement (the suppress_label setting) — is it on or off?
evals.expected_output: It is on: paragraph_blocks.settings:suppress_label is true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure paragraph_blocks so that unlimited paragraph fields offer up to 20 paragraph delta blocks for placement (max_cardinality = 20). Apply the change to the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, configure paragraph_blocks to hide the redundant block label field when placing paragraph blocks (since the paragraph admin title is already used as the label). Apply the change to the live configuration.
